metadata.title: Add audited stock adjustments and reservation reporting
metadata.body:
Add atomic stock correction batches with adjustment IDs, reason validation, detached audit history, and safe stock restoration. Add an independent reservation query/report workflow with detached rows, validated filters, deterministic order, safe status totals, and exact expiry summaries. Authenticated handlers and a composition factory expose both workflows over the existing global inventory model.

Validation: pinned TypeScript build; 65 expanded workflow assertions and 13 original regressions; strict public-export consumer compilation; clean diff whitespace check. External assertions are outside the analyzed repository. In-process batch atomicity and existing live reserve/expire references retain the fixture's documented limits.

# Commerce operations PR review repository

This deterministic TypeScript workspace models checkout, inventory reservations,
payments, cancellation, outbox delivery, job leases, and reservation expiry. It
uses in-memory state and injected clocks and IDs so pull-request analysis is
stable.

```sh
npm ci
npm run build
```

The repository is intentionally outside Daphne's tracked source. Its local Git
history supplies exact BASE and HEAD commits and can later be published for a
real pull-request run. Scenario tooling and answer keys live in the sibling
`commerce-fixture/` directory so Daphne cannot see them in analyzed source.

The model exercises explicit interleavings only. It does not claim database
transaction isolation or distributed delivery guarantees.
